candidate.document_title: NASA Manufacturing and Test Requirements for Normally Closed Pyrovalves for Hazardous Flight Systems Applications

requirements.source_excerpt: All valves shall be proof tested to a minimum pneumatic proof pressure at 1.5xMEOP.
requirements.engineering_meaning: Every valve requires a pneumatic proof-pressure test at not less than 1.5 times MEOP.
normalized_constraints: Applies to: all valves.
Test type: pneumatic proof-pressure test.
Proof pressure >= 1.5 × MEOP.

requirements.source_excerpt: This capability shall be demonstrated on every unit during assembly.
requirements.engineering_meaning: The applicable proof-pressure capability must be demonstrated on every unit during assembly, using separate pressure applications to each line and to the housing through the actuation ram chamber while lines are vented.
normalized_constraints: Applies to: every unit.
Timing: during assembly.
Apply pressure individually to each line.
Apply pressure separately to valve housing through actuation ram chamber.
Vent lines during housing pressure application.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Every unit during assembly; lines are vented for the housing pressure application.

requirements.source_excerpt: The test shall be performed on all parent metal shear-section and all parts of the valve exposed to pressure.
requirements.engineering_meaning: The test applies to every parent-metal shear-section and every valve part that will be pressure-exposed after actuation.
normalized_constraints: Test coverage includes all parent-metal shear-sections.
Test coverage includes all valve parts exposed to pressure after valve actuation.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Valve parts are included when exposed to pressure after valve actuation.

requirements.source_excerpt: All welds shall be leak tested either during assembly or acceptance testing.
requirements.engineering_meaning: Every weld must receive leak testing, performed at either the assembly stage or acceptance-testing stage.
normalized_constraints: Applies to: all welds.
Required action: leak test.
Permitted timing: during assembly OR during acceptance testing.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: All welds; timing may be either during assembly or acceptance testing.

requirements.source_excerpt: Either non-destructive acceptance testing shall be accomplished or the risk of defects be mitigated through process control.
requirements.engineering_meaning: Defect risk must be addressed by one of two alternatives: conduct non-destructive acceptance testing or mitigate defect risk through process control.
normalized_constraints: Required alternative: non-destructive acceptance testing OR defect-risk mitigation through process control.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: One of the two stated alternatives is required.

requirements.source_excerpt: If process control is used, approval shall be obtained from the NASA Fracture Control Board.
requirements.engineering_meaning: When process control is used, obtain NASA Fracture Control Board approval for spacecraft whose programmatic requirements require that approval.
normalized_constraints: IF process control is used AND programmatic requirements require NASA Fracture Control Board approval for the spacecraft, THEN obtain that approval.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Conditional on use of process control and applicability of the programmatic approval requirement.

requirements.source_excerpt: Growth of the maximum credible crack size shall be demonstrated to the fracture control authority to be non-credible.
requirements.engineering_meaning: If fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis is used for NASA-STD-5019 compliance verification, demonstrate to the fracture-control authority that growth of the maximum credible crack is non-credible, based on manufacturing and quality-control knowledge.
normalized_constraints: IF fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis is used to verify NASA-STD-5019 compliance, THEN demonstrate maximum credible crack growth is non-credible to the fracture control authority.
Basis includes knowledge of quality-control and manufacturing techniques used for the valve.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies only when fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis is used for the stated compliance verification.

requirements.source_excerpt: The NC parent metal valve shall be capable of surviving four times the design operational life.
requirements.engineering_meaning: Regardless of how the capability is technically established, the valve must survive at least four times its design operational life.
normalized_constraints: Valve survivability >= 4 × design operational life.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies regardless of the technical method used to establish the capability.

requirements.source_excerpt: This capability shall be verified by proof testing at 1.5xMEOP, independently applied to each parent metal shear-section.
requirements.engineering_meaning: A design intended to provide two separate independent parent-metal flow barriers before actuation must be verified by 1.5×MEOP proof testing of each shear-section independently and then externally after housing welding, without permanent deformation or leakage during LAT.
normalized_constraints: IF design provides two separate and independent parent-metal barriers before actuation, THEN proof-test at 1.5 × MEOP.
Apply proof pressure independently to each parent-metal shear-section.
Then apply proof pressure externally to the shear-section after it is welded in the housing.
Acceptance criterion during LAT: no evidence of permanent deformation AND no leakage.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies if the valve design is intended to provide two separate and independent parent-metal barriers before actuation; verification occurs during LAT.

requirements.source_excerpt: The minimum hold time for each burst pressure test shall be 5 min.
requirements.engineering_meaning: Every burst-pressure test must maintain its test condition for at least five minutes.
normalized_constraints: Applies to: each burst-pressure test.
Burst-test hold time >= 5 min.

requirements.source_excerpt: Minimum design burst pressure of 2.5xMEOP for lines with diameters ≥3.8 cm or 4.0xMEOP for lines <3.8 cm.
requirements.engineering_meaning: The minimum design burst-pressure multiplier depends on line diameter: 2.5×MEOP for lines at least 3.8 cm (1.5 in) in diameter, and 4.0×MEOP for smaller lines.
normalized_constraints: IF line diameter >= 3.8 cm (>= 1.5 in), THEN minimum design burst pressure >= 2.5 × MEOP.
IF line diameter < 3.8 cm (< 1.5 in), THEN minimum design burst pressure >= 4.0 × MEOP.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies to all NC parent-metal valves; threshold selection depends on line diameter.

requirements.source_excerpt: This capability shall be demonstrated on at least one NC parent metal valve from each lot.
requirements.engineering_meaning: The applicable burst-pressure capability must be demonstrated using no fewer than one NC parent-metal valve from every manufacturing lot.
normalized_constraints: Sampling basis: each lot.
Minimum test sample: >= 1 NC parent-metal valve per lot.
Demonstrate the applicable NCPR 28 burst-pressure capability.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: At least one NC parent-metal valve from each lot.
